items.title: Meta spend Oct 1-7: $342.45, 18 leads, CPL $19.03
items.summary: Seven-day window spent $342.45 CAD across 9,403 impressions and 215 clicks for 18 leads. Flooring Problems Campaign was the only campaign with delivery.

needs_attention: Last prior meta-ads.json was 2026-09-08 (30 days ago); window widened to the 7-day cap (2026-10-01 to 2026-10-07). Gap before 2026-10-01 is not covered, and spend/leads metrics are for 7 days, not one.
No separate CPL baseline exists (the 7-day window was the only pull), so no anomaly comparison was run.
